citations.assessment: The internal Avin article cites the exact Niddah locus and independently discusses whether it belongs there. The Bavli’s Avin bar Rav Adda and Rav Menaḥem names are distinct readings from the root.

notes.text: Niddah contains the named speaker’s report explicitly pointing to Yehudah and Ḥizkiyah, sons of Ḥiyya, as present. Keep Heilprin’s own failed lookup as a statement about his inquiry.
